dialogues.speaker: Araby
dialogues.text: I'm an Amu{RUBY#[S]Biology}rta researcher from the Akademiya, primarily studying sea creatures.

dialogues.speaker: Araby
dialogues.text: And responsible for the upkeep of the lighthouse while at it.

dialogues.speaker: Araby
dialogues.text: To be honest, I know very little about lighthouses. It's the Kshahrewar researchers who are the experts...

dialogues.speaker: Araby
dialogues.text: I can't figure out why the sages would make such an arrangement... Probably because I was here already.
